answer: An agent economy can require each identity to complete a fresh sequential delay puzzle every epoch — work that cannot be parallelized, so running a thousand fake identities costs a thousand waits. A sybil farm's advantage collapses because nectar from one fast machine cannot feed many mouths. The failure mode is a puzzle too easy to outsource to idle hardware, so the delay must be bound to the identity's own registered key. The check: a trellis of attestations records each identity's puzzle completion time, and any signal arriving before the minimum delay proves cheating.
